external_coverage.exact_statement: For projective X over a complete non-Archimedean field and a semiample Q-line bundle L, the class of all-point decreasing limits of real-weight FS metrics on L is closed under further decreasing nets, including the identically −∞ limit (BE2021v3, Definition 7.2, Lemma 7.4, Corollary 7.5).

On projective X over a complete non-Archimedean field, FS metrics on a Q-line bundle L have the form m^−1 maxα(log|sα|+bα), with mL integral, finitely many sections without common zeroes, and real bα (BE2021v3, Definition 5.2).
Over any complete non-Archimedean K and for n≥1, standard FS on (P^n_K,O(1)) equals the canonical P^n_{K°}/O(1) model metric (BE2021v3, Theorem 5.14, proof).

For geometrically integral projective n-dimensional X over complete algebraically closed nontrivially valued non-Archimedean F, Q-models ℒ_i on a projective model with reduced special fiber induce the continuous mixed dpsh measure Σ_Y(ℒ₁|Y⋯ℒₙ|Y)δ_{x_Y}, where x_Y is the unique Shilov point reducing to each component’s generic point (BE2021v3, Example 8.11, (8.3); CLD2012v1, 6.9.2–6.9.6).
The completed algebraic closure of a complete non-Archimedean real-valued field is a complete algebraically closed valued extension with the extended absolute value (BE2021v3, §1.1).
